projects.title: AdminCore - Enterprise Access Management
projects.description: Full-stack RBAC platform: React 19 + TypeScript SPA with .NET 10 Web API backend following clean architecture patterns.
projects.tech: React 19, TypeScript, .NET 10, SQL Server, SignalR, Zustand, React Query, ECharts
projects.problem: Enterprise teams lacked granular access control, with no real-time visibility into user sessions or permission management.
projects.solution: Built a full-stack RBAC platform with JWT + GitHub OAuth SSO, device fingerprinting, CAPTCHA, and secure session lifecycle management with real-time SignalR dashboard.
impact: Engineered granular permission engine with menu-level and action-level controls using SQL Server stored procedures, managing 50+ rules
Integrated SignalR WebSocket for real-time dashboard updates and live session monitoring across concurrent clients
Designed frontend state layer with Zustand + React Query for optimistic updates, cache invalidation, and server-state sync
Built audit logging, document management with file preview, and interactive ECharts analytics with CSV export
Optimized data access with dual ORM: Entity Framework Core for CRUD + Dapper for high-performance stored procedure calls
Deployed the full-stack React and .NET application on Windows Server using IIS, configuring application pools and site bindings for production hosting
projects.challenges: Balancing granular permission control with a clean, intuitive UI while maintaining real-time synchronization across concurrent users.
projects.architecture: Layered .NET 10 Web API (Controllers, Services, Repository, Utility) with React 19 SPA using Zustand + React Query for state management.

projects.title: P2P - Supply Chain Management System
projects.description: Architected end-to-end supply chain platform with procurement, logistics, and warehouse modules serving 100+ users.
projects.tech: Node.js, Express.js, Sequelize, MySQL, Tailwind CSS
projects.problem: Manual supply chain processes were slow and error-prone, lacking real-time visibility into inventory and procurement.
projects.solution: Built a unified P2P platform with automated workflows for purchase orders, GRN validation, and real-time warehouse monitoring.
impact: Engineered purchase order workflows, GRN validation, and invoice automation reducing processing time by 40%
Built real-time warehouse operations and supplier tracking improving inventory accuracy by 25%
Handled 1K+ daily transactions with optimized Sequelize ORM database operations
projects.challenges: Integrating real-time tracking across diverse modules (logistics, procurement, warehouse) while ensuring high data consistency.
projects.architecture: Modular backend using Express.js and Sequelize ORM, with a responsive frontend built on Tailwind CSS.

projects.title: Purchase Request Management System
projects.description: Role-based PR workflow with buyer head assignment, category access controls, and SAP integration.
projects.problem: Unregulated purchase requests and manual assignment were causing delays and budget overruns.
projects.solution: Designed a central management system with automated limit enforcement and SAP vendor data synchronization.
impact: Created role-based PR workflow with buyer head assignment and category access controls
Built RESTful APIs and cross-database queries for SAP integration and vendor synchronization
projects.challenges: Synchronizing data across multiple databases and SAP systems while maintaining performance for search and validation.
projects.architecture: LAMP stack application with RESTful APIs for cross-system integration and dynamic frontend validation.

projects.title: Gesture-Controlled Video Player
projects.description: Hands-free media control system using real-time computer vision with OpenCV and MediaPipe.
projects.problem: Traditional media controls are inconvenient when hands are occupied or users are distant from the screen.
projects.solution: Developed a computer vision pipeline to detect hand landmarks and map them to media controls like play, pause, volume, and seek.
impact: Integrated hands-free control for common media actions
Leveraged lightweight AI models for low-latency performance
projects.challenges: Optimizing image processing for real-time responsiveness on standard hardware.
projects.architecture: Python-based application using OpenCV for video capture and MediaPipe for hand tracking and gesture logic.

projects.title: FamilyVerse Platform
projects.description: Cross-platform family communication app: a React Native mobile client and a React web app sharing one Firebase backend.
projects.tech: React Native, Expo, React, TypeScript, Firebase, Socket.io, Vercel
projects.problem: Families wanted one place for messaging, calls, and shared files instead of juggling separate apps across phones and browsers.
projects.solution: Built a cross-platform app - a React Native mobile client and a React web client on a shared TypeScript codebase - backed by Firebase for auth, real-time data, and storage, with Socket.io/WebRTC for live calling.
impact: Built a cross-platform family communication platform with a React Native mobile app and a React web application on TypeScript
Integrated Firebase for authentication, real-time database, push notifications, and cloud storage across mobile and web
Implemented real-time messaging and WebRTC video/audio calling via Socket.io
Added Razorpay payment integration and in-app document/file management
Deployed the web app to Vercel with an optimized build and performance monitoring
projects.challenges: Keeping the React Native mobile app and React web app in sync on a shared codebase while supporting real-time messaging, calls, and file sync on both.
projects.architecture: React Native + Expo mobile app and a React/TypeScript web app, both backed by Firebase (auth, realtime database, storage, notifications) with Socket.io and WebRTC for live communication.
